role.summary: Prepares theatres for orthopaedic lists and arranges loan implant kits with suppliers

tasks.name: Arrange loan implant kits
tasks.why_priority: Only the giver does it; one kit due 3 Dec

tasks.name: Prepare theatre for an ortho list

deadlines.what: Loan kit for revision hip list (rep not yet confirmed)

waiting_on_us.what: Confirmation call for the 3 Dec kit

processes.name: Arrange loan implant kits
processes.summary: Book, confirm and track supplier loan kits so they are sterilised in time
processes.trigger: A case needing a loan kit appears on the list

people.involvement: Escalation if the kit is late

steps.title: Spot cases needing a loan kit
steps.detail: Check next week's list for revisions and procedures using supplier implants
steps.why: Kits need lead time for delivery and sterilisation

steps.title: Call the rep one week before
steps.detail: Phone the rep, then send an email confirming kit, date and theatre
steps.why: Phone gets a quick yes; the email is the record
steps.source: giver: AI could draft the email

steps.title: Check the kit has arrived by 2 pm the day before
steps.detail: Ask CSSD whether the kit arrived and is booked for sterilisation
steps.why: The hospital requires 48 hours for sterilisation (ORT-07); 2 pm is the giver's cut-off to still escalate

steps.title: Escalate to the theatre coordinator
steps.detail: Tell the coordinator so the list can be changed in time
steps.why: Starting without a sterile kit is never an option

steps.title: Note the kit on the case record
steps.detail: Record kit name and CSSD confirmation as ORT-07 requires

rules.text: Loan kits must be with CSSD 48 hours before the case
rules.source: ORT-07 as quoted by the giver

rules.text: Contact the rep one week ahead
rules.why: Giver's practice; leaves room for delays

scenarios.situation: It's 3 pm the day before a revision hip and CSSD hasn't seen the kit.
scenarios.question: What do you do?
options: Escalate to the theatre coordinator now
Ask the surgeon to bring one
scenarios.explanation: Past the 2 pm cut-off, escalate so the list can change (P01.S04).

processes.name: Prepare theatre for an ortho list
processes.summary: Room and positioning equipment checks before the first case

steps.title: Follow ORT-07 room set-up
steps.detail: Use the official checklist; this pack does not repeat it
steps.why: The protocol is the source of truth

steps.title: Check traction table and padding
steps.detail: Traction table working, padding present for pressure areas
steps.check: If padding is missing, do not start

Turnover between cases was not captured
